name: Moral Bankruptcy
body:
School illusion; Level antipaladin 1, cleric/oracle 2, inquisitor 2, lathspell 1, mesmerist 2, witch 2

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a silver piece)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You put a pall of wild alignments and moral pulls over the target. For the duration, the target qualifies as the least beneficial alignment for them when subject to alignment-based spells and effects. For example, a lawful good paladin could be affected by smite good and smite evil. Protection from evil would cause any summoned creature affected by this spell to be treated as evil for the purposes of the spell. In addition, whenever the target is subject to an alignment-detecting spell or effect, they register as the directly opposing alignment of the creature performing the detection; if the creature is neutral, it is the caster’s choice.

Moral Bankruptcy, Mass

School illusion; Level antipaladin 2, cleric/oracle 4, inquisitor 3, lathspell 2, mesmerist 3, witch 4
Target one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart.

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as moral bankruptcy, except as noted above.
